signature.one_line: Two-person podcast clip cut on speaker changes, with stacked word-by-word captions: small white lead words over one giant glowing accent UPPERCASE keyword on the chest.
unique_devices: Stacked keyword build: 1-3 small white bold lead words (54 px, +0.05em) left-aligned directly on top of one ~2.1x UPPERCASE black-weight keyword (114 px, +0.03em) in accent #9EC43A with a lighter diagonal sheen band and a soft accent glow; 0-2 trailing words indented below; every word hard-cuts in as spoken
Keyword centre fixed at 63.7 % height, block nudged over the speaker's chest (x 42-50 %) so it never covers the face; one keyword every ~60-90 frames, reaction shots left uncaptioned

Speaker-change-only cutting: wider MS for the first shot then tighter MCUs (punch-in feel from framing alone), a laughing reaction cut early, the quotable payoff held in the longest shot (~40 % of runtime), no CTA so it loops
Crushed-black set with teal rim light; picture fills the top ~83 % of the canvas with plain black below
signature.why_it_works: A context-free question plus a real laugh opens a loop; the glowing keyword carries meaning muted, and the held payoff line gives a quotable, loopable ending.

hook.first_frame: medium shot of the host at a podcast desk mic, mid-laugh on a crushed-black set; small white lead words over a big glowing accent keyword at ~64 % height

structure.what: mid-conversation question from the host, cut to the guest's laughing reaction
the familiar paradox stated, then voiced by the guest from experience
host's quick confirmation beat; camera drifts closer
guest's quotable line in one long hold; ends without CTA (loops)

pacing.note: front-loaded (~24 cuts/min in the first half), then one long payoff hold; cuts only on speaker change or reaction, 40 % on pauses, 60 % J-leads, none mid-sentence

captions.what: stacked keyword captions (small lead / BIG keyword / small trail)
captions.how: lead/trail: bold neo-grotesque 54 px white, +0.05em, faint glow; keyword: black-weight UPPERCASE 114 px, +0.03em, accent with diagonal sheen band, glow 0 0 40px rgba(158,196,58,.35); keyword centre y 63.7 %, block x 42-50 % over the chest; lead line left-aligned on the keyword's cap height; per-word hard cut as spoken; whole stack hard-cuts out on the next phrase or speaker cut

layout.what: picture in the top ~83 % with a black band below
layout.how: podcast frame fills the upper ~83 % of 9:16; bottom ~17 % plain black (or fill it when footage allows)

camera.how: first shot a wider MS, all later shots tighter MCUs; one slow push-in during the confirmation beat

transitions.what: hard cuts on speaker change / reaction only
transitions.how: never mid-sentence; J-leads into the next speaker

captions_spec.punctuation: dropped (no commas, question marks or quotes on screen); apostrophes kept (I'm, it's)

grouping.key_words_per_caption: 1 (the topic word of the phrase: a strong noun or verb, ~1 every 60-90 frames)
grouping.sync: word-by-word build: each word (lead or key) hard-cuts in as spoken and stays until the phrase clears
grouping.break: new phrase every ~60-90 frames; phrases with no strong keyword show the small white line alone
grouping.gaps: no caption on pure reaction shots (e.g. the other person laughing)

lead.above_key: left-aligned with the keyword's left edge, directly above it
lead.below_key: indented under the keyword (right-aligned to it when it fits, otherwise a ~5 % W indent)

layout.block_center_x_pct_of_W: 42-50: roughly centred, nudged over the speaker's chest
layout.no_key_word: small white line alone at ~60-62 % height
layout.on_1080x1920: same 9:16 canvas: keyword centre y ≈ 1223 px; picture fills the top ~83 %, bottom ~17 % is black

lead.font_class: neo-grotesque sans, bold (Inter-like: straight-tailed y, flat-topped t)
lead.k_note: two-word lead lines with ascenders + descenders -> k 0.99: 2.58 x 19.2 / 0.99 = 50 px; render-verified with Inter 700: 54 px
lead.calibration_note: measured over dark clothing; a second two-word lead line read 2.50 % H; one under-detected line was discarded

key.font_class: neo-grotesque sans, black weight, wide caps
key.k_note: all caps, no descenders -> k 0.73: 4.45 x 19.2 / 0.73 = 117 px (about 2.1x the lead size); render-verified with Inter 900: 114 px
key.calibration_note: measured with --ink #AACA51:25 (glow excluded); a third keyword read 4.45 % H
key.color: lime #9EC43A base with a lighter diagonal sheen band #B6D372 across the middle letters (measured column means #9EC43A -> #B6D372 -> #9EC63A)
key.shadow: soft lime glow behind the word, fading to black over ~50 px at 720p: ~0 0 40px rgba(158,196,58,.35) at 1920 (estimated)
key.leading_to_lead_line: tight: lead line sits directly on the keyword's cap height

animation.lead_entry: hard cut per word, full size and opacity on its first frame; words already placed never move
animation.key_entry: hard cut, full size on its first frame (ink height constant from that frame: no pop, no scale, no fade)
animation.timing: ~10-11 frames after the transcript word start on the measured words (transcript timings in this clip read early, so align to the audible word)
animation.highlight: only the keyword is coloured; no colour sweep
animation.exit: the whole stack hard-cuts out when the next phrase starts or on the speaker cut

other_text_spec.text: no text; the podcast picture occupies the top ~83 % of the 9:16 canvas and the bottom ~17 % is plain black

other_text_spec.type: titles / name lower-thirds / logo bug / end card
other_text_spec.text: none (a branded prop in the scene is footage, not a graphic)

style.look_intent: crushed-black set where faces pop: deep blacks, cool teal rim light, warm skin, punchy but muted overall (measured mid-contrast, muted, warm); do not copy heavy sharpening

sound.music: music bed likely (heuristic, speech-gap level -3.3 dB); low, unobtrusive under the conversation
sfx: none (cuts are on speaker changes, not hits)

sound.method: heuristic (onset-envelope beat periodicity + level in speech gaps); not a classifier

use_when: cutting a short clip from a two-person podcast or interview
the exchange has a clear quotable payoff line
the set is dark so a bright keyword colour and glow pop
muted viewing matters and one topic word per phrase can carry meaning
avoid_when: a single-speaker monologue with no reactions to cut to
a bright, white or busy background where the glow reads muddy
long-form explainers needing lists, screens or b-roll
brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B20 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B20.json) to this brand.
Canvas 1080x1920, 30 fps. All positions are % of frame; px are at 1080x1920.

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour/font for each role; keep the contrast relationship: {{ACCENT}} must stay >= 3:1 on the dark set and visibly brighter than skin; {{ACCENT_2}} is a lighter tint of {{ACCENT}} for the sheen)
- {{TEXT}}      lead / trailing words                    default #FFFFFF
- {{ACCENT}}    keyword fill and glow                    default #9EC43A (lime)
- {{ACCENT_2}}  diagonal sheen band across the keyword   default #B6D372
- {{SURFACE}}   black band below the picture / set       default #000000
- {{CARD_BG}}   none                                     default none
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}} keyword                               default Inter 900 (black-weight neo-grotesque, wide caps)
- {{FONT_BODY}}    lead / trailing words                 default Inter 700
- {{HANDLE}}    not shown (optional: add a guest name lower third only if the brand needs it)
- {{LOGO}}      not shown

CAPTIONS
1. English as spoken. Lead words in sentence case; the keyword in UPPERCASE. Drop commas, question marks and quotes; keep apostrophes.
2. Per phrase: 1-3 small lead words, then ONE keyword (the topic word: a strong noun or verb, about one every 60-90 frames), then 0-2 small trailing words. Max 3 lines. Phrases without a strong keyword show only the small white line (at ~60-62 % height).
3. Lead/trailing words: {{FONT_BODY}} at 54 px, tracking +0.05em, {{TEXT}}, no stroke, no box, faint soft glow.
4. Keyword: {{FONT_DISPLAY}} at 114 px (~2.1x the lead), tracking +0.03em, {{ACCENT}} with a lighter diagonal {{ACCENT_2}} sheen band across the middle letters, soft glow 0 0 40px of {{ACCENT}} at 35 % opacity, no stroke, no box.
5. Layout: stack tightly. The lead line sits directly on the keyword's cap height, left-aligned with its left edge; the trailing line goes under the keyword, indented (right-aligned to it when it fits). Keyword centre at 63.7 % of height (y ~1223 px); block roughly centred (x 42-50 %), nudged over the speaker's chest so it never covers the face.
6. Animation: build word by word; each word (small or keyword) hard-cuts in at full size and opacity on the audible word; placed words never move. No pop, scale, fade or colour sweep. The whole stack hard-cuts out when the next phrase starts or on a speaker cut. Leave pure reaction shots uncaptioned.

OTHER TEXT
7. None: no title, name lower thirds or logo bug. If the source is not 9:16, place the picture in the top ~83 % with {{SURFACE}} below.

EDIT DEVICES
8. Open mid-conversation on a question (first word in the first ~2 frames) and cut to the other person's laughing reaction within ~50 frames. Cut only on speaker change or reaction (median shot ~70 frames, J-leads, never mid-sentence). First shot a wider MS, later shots tighter MCUs; hold the quotable payoff in the longest shot; no CTA so it loops.

GRADE
9. Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py); target look: crushed-black set, faces pop, cool teal rim light, warm skin; no heavy sharpening.

AUDIO
10. Low music bed under the conversation (optional); no SFX. Master to about -14.1 LUFS, true peak <= -1 dBTP.

VERIFY before rendering
a) Render a test frame with the stack "KEY WORD / MEET / with you" and one with "LOVE" as the keyword, over a dark area, and measure:
   python video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <test.mp4> --out <dir> --at <t> --box 0.05,0.55,0.95,0.72 --ink "{{ACCENT}}:30,{{TEXT}}:60"
   Required at the default fonts: "MEET" ink 4.38 % ±0.5 of height and 30.6 % ±2 of width; "LOVE" 4.53 % and 28.5 % ±2; "with you" 2.66 % ±0.5 and 20.8 % ±2; keyword centre y 63.7 % ±0.5. With brand fonts, compute the expected ink with video-reference-match/scripts/fit_font.py ({{FONT_DISPLAY}} 114 px +0.03em; {{FONT_BODY}} 54 px +0.05em) and match within ±0.5 % H.
